paraphrase: OPEN analyst reading of ST I q.7 a.1 co.: whatever is its own subsistent being (the primitive own-being predicate) is infinite (the primitive Infinite, infinity of perfection). The passage infers God's infinity from his being his own subsistent esse, not received in anything; STMT-SUBSISTENT-BEING-IS-INFINITE reads the same sentence with a represented essence/esse equality in place of own being, and no record identifies the two antecedents.
